title: Unique Spicy Ethiopian Samphire Berbere Stew Bake
description: A spicy and crisp Ethiopian dish featuring samphire in a berbere stew, perfect for a brunch mood, onion and garlic free, served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
Rinse the samphire and cut it into 5cm pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the berbere spice mix, tomato paste, coconut oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the samphire to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the samphire mixture to a baking dish and add the water.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the samphire is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the samphire berbere stew hot, directly on a wooden board.
